description: Biomedical MCP server: genes, variants, trials, literature, patents, optional SQL/R/biowasm tools.
name: io.github.yeyuan98/biomcp-ts

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable the samtools/bedtools/bcftools biowasm analysis tools
environmentVariables.name: ANALYSIS_BIOWASM

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable the R/Bioconductor analysis tools (requires the webr peer dependency; use the pinned one-shot client command)
environmentVariables.name: ANALYSIS_R

environmentVariables.description: Set to mysql or sqlite to enable the read-only SQL database tools
environmentVariables.name: DB_TYPE

environmentVariables.description: Higher NCBI E-utilities rate limits (3 -> 10 req/s)
environmentVariables.name: NCBI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Required by the variant_oncokb tool (OncoKB annotations)
environmentVariables.name: ONCOKB_TOKEN

title: BioMCP-TS
